title: Your team and organisation: invite, roles, workspaces

say: Bring your whole team into Sales X-Ray.
अपनी पूरी team को Sales X-Ray में लाइए.
caption: Apni poori team ko Sales X-Ray mein laaiye.

say: तुमची पूर्ण team Sales X-Ray मध्ये आणा.
caption: Tumchi poorna team Sales X-Ray madhye aana.

say: Open Settings, then Team.
Everyone in your organisation is here, with their role: owner, admin or member.
Settings खोलिए, फिर Team.
आपकी organisation के सारे लोग यहाँ हैं, उनके role के साथ: owner, admin या member.
caption: Settings kholiye, phir Team.
Aapki organisation ke saare log yahan hain, unke role ke saath: owner, admin ya member.

say: Settings उघडा, मग Team.
तुमच्या organisation मधले सगळे लोक इथे आहेत, त्यांच्या role सकट: owner, admin किंवा member.
caption: Settings ughda, mag Team.
Tumchya organisation madhle sagle lok ithe aahet, tyanchya role sakat: owner, admin kinva member.

say: To add someone, type their email, pick a role, and tap Invite.
They get an invite to join your organisation.
किसी को add करना है? उनका email डालिए, role चुनिए, और Invite दबाइए.
उन्हें आपकी organisation join करने का invite मिल जाता है.
caption: Kisi ko add karna hai? Unka email daaliye, role chuniye, aur Invite dabaiye.
Unhe aapki organisation join karne ka invite mil jaata hai.

say: कोणाला add करायचंय? त्यांचा email टाका, role निवडा, आणि Invite दाबा.
त्यांना तुमची organisation join करायचं invite मिळतं.
caption: Konala add karaychay? Tyancha email taka, role nivda, aani Invite daba.
Tyanna tumchi organisation join karaycha invite milta.

say: On a computer, Organisation holds your company details.
Add your company's email domain and turn on Join automatically, so your sellers can join without an invite.
Computer पे, Organisation में आपकी company की details हैं.
अपनी company का email domain add कीजिए और Join automatically on कीजिए, ताकि आपके sellers बिना invite के join कर सकें.
caption: Computer pe, Organisation mein aapki company ki details hain.
Apni company ka email domain add kijiye aur Join automatically on kijiye, taaki aapke sellers bina invite ke join kar sakein.

say: Computer वर, Organisation मध्ये तुमच्या company ची details आहेत.
तुमच्या company चा email domain add करा आणि Join automatically on करा, म्हणजे तुमचे sellers invite शिवाय join करू शकतात.
caption: Computer var, Organisation madhye tumchya company chi details aahet.
Tumchya company cha email domain add kara aani Join automatically on kara, mhanje tumche sellers invite shivay join karu shaktat.

say: Every seller also has a personal workspace.
Tap the name at the top to switch between your organisation and your personal space.
हर seller का एक personal workspace भी होता है.
ऊपर नाम पे tap कीजिए, और organisation और personal space के बीच switch कीजिए.
caption: Har seller ka ek personal workspace bhi hota hai.
Upar naam pe tap kijiye, aur organisation aur personal space ke beech switch kijiye.

say: प्रत्येक seller चा एक personal workspace पण असतो.
वर नावावर tap करा, आणि organisation आणि personal space मध्ये switch करा.
caption: Pratyek seller cha ek personal workspace pan asto.
Var navavar tap kara, aani organisation aani personal space madhye switch kara.
